correctness.rationale: For every odd prime power the rational tangent vector vanishes precisely at roots of T^7+kT^3-1. Restriction to each rational line has simple Frobenius factor times nonzero binary quadratic; its determinant is the quartic H_k. Exact char-3 and char-7 exceptions and the integer identity 3bH_B=aH_A+3(3+4kb)H_C-4a(kb+1)(6kb+7) prove H_k geometrically smooth whenever the polynomial is rootfree. Genus three and an exact incidence double count give N_1=#H_k(F_q), N_0=N_2=(q^2+q+1-N_1)/2 and the Weil bound. Proof assumptions/normalization cover every projective chart. A standard-library checker reproduced the line-fiber and H_k counts for 41 parameters across 9 prime fields and direct line/point incidences in seven smaller prime fields; samples are not relied on for the infinite statement.
